bdd_style: Short business-readable scenarios with one happy path and one negative/edge path, written from a hiring-manager or recruiter visitor perspective
common_risks: outdated or inaccurate content (stale job titles, dates, skills)
broken external links (GitHub repos, certificates, source URLs)
missing or unclear evidence for claimed skills/projects
poor readability or navigation on mobile devices
known_bug_patterns: dead links to project repos or certificates
content sections not rendering or truncated
responsive layout breaking on smaller viewports
outdated information not reflecting most recent role/skills
missing alt text or accessibility issues on key content
